walkability_summary|gale.limitation: Objects smaller than the grid cell (boulders, small steps) are not resolved: roughness and obstacle density describe terrain texture at the cell scale only. Weights are assumptions. Cells above the walking slope limit are impassable (W = 0).

note: Precomputed by the Python core; start_utc is fixed, so sun-dependent costs are for that instant.
